votes.motion: Approve minutes from the work session meetings of June 3, 2021; June 8, 2021; June 10, 2021; June 21, 2021; July 12, 2022; July 19, 2022; September 6, 2022; October 11, 2022 as well as formal meeting minutes of July 20, 2021; August 29, 2022; September 6, 2022; October 11, 2022.
votes.description: The Council approved a set of previously held work session and formal meeting minutes spanning from June 2021 through October 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 38 of 2022 declaring November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall officially designating November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone at 856 West 1300 South.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone of 856 West 1300 South from R-1/5,000 to FB-UN1 and deferred a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Digital Equipment Donation Program resolution.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a resolution authorizing donation of surplus City computers to nonprofits for disadvantaged communities and deferred a final vote to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone and master plan amendment at 675 N F Street (Capitol Park Cottages).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from FR-3/12,000 to SR-1 and a master plan amendment for a 19-lot single-family development by Ivory Development and deferred a final decision.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 72 of 2022 Alley Vacation at approximately 925 South 1200 West.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance vacating a portion of a City-owned alley adjacent to 925 South 1200 West, incorporating the vacated land into the neighboring property near the 9-Line trail.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 73 of 2022 Stealth Towers Text Amendments.
votes.description: The Council adopted a zoning ordinance amendment allowing stealth wireless telecommunication facilities up to 75 feet in height (previously limited to 35 feet) within the Public Lands zoning district citywide.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 39 of 2022 Salt Lake City International Airport Master Plan, with amendments including priority points on carbon footprint reduction from single occupancy vehicle traffic and strategies for customers who experience accessibility barriers, and associated legislative intents.
votes.description: The Council adopted the 2022 Salt Lake City International Airport Master Plan Update with added appendix priorities focusing on reducing vehicle-related carbon emissions and improving accessibility for travelers, along with legislative intents calling for multi-partner transit-focused meetings.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for a rezone/alley vacation and a budget amendment, as well as board appointments and reappointments to the Business Advisory Board, Transportation Advisory Board, Accessibility and Disability Commission, and Airport Board.
